title: Not for beginners...
text:
Not for beginners.... THE GOOD:
--------------
* Seems like a high quality machine. Very well built
* Default is set to seal 95mm cups, but you get three extra adapters for 85 and 90mm cups.
* Heats up fairly fast, 3 minutes is the specification.

THE BAD:
-----------
* They don't seem to be targeting regular homeowners because the instructions are woefully inadequate. If you are in the business, or have used these machines before, I'm sure you'll be okay. For me, it was all trial and error, and based on my trial and error, here are questions newbies will have, which a manual should have addressed:

1. Orientation of the roller film. They do have a diagram that I followed, only to realize the seal was upside down. A youtube video help me get it right, which I will talk about below.
2. How long do I press the cup without burning it? You know why I realize this is a question that should be addressed? Because some of my cups came out burnt, plastic melted. Look at my picture. LOL!
3. How far do we crank the handle? At times I felt like I might be crushing the cup and the drinks will spill. Because no matter how hard I push, the film just wouldn't cut. It would only create a perforation. I then manually separate it. This may have something to do with the height of my cup versus the level of the base. You can use a screw driver to move the base up or down. I will have to trial and error with the height of the base to figure out if this is what's causing the issue.

You see what I mean? There should be a manual with operational advice, recommendations and tips. There is nothing. You are on your own, it is 100% trial and error to learn this machine. If you want to know how to put the roller film in property, search YT using this phrase.. "Cup Sealer Machine Unboxing Demo - Verly." You will get an unboxing demo by a guy name Zian Vlag. He uses a different model, but I can see the roller guides for the film are the same. By watching him, I then realized my film was upside down. I am sure this is a 5-Star machine, but without an operational manual, or even company videos, this is a 2-Star product overall.
